newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia July palm oil exports at 722,389 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia July palm oil exports at 722,389 tonnes.

text.p: Cargo surveyor Caleb Brett put Malaysia's July bulk palm oil exports at 722,389 tonnes against its estimate of 634,753 tonnes for June, traders said.
The figures include laurics and oleochemicals but exclude shipments to Singapore and exports in drum, said the traders who obtained the data by facsimile.
The Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority put official June exports at 612,124 tonnes.
